# Salman Local AI Agent

> A local AI agent that runs entirely on one machine and talks to a local SQLite/Postgres database through a plugin system, driven by a fully local LLM via Ollama. No data or prompts leave the machine. Currently RC1 (`0.1.0-rc1`), feature-frozen, in real-usage dogfooding.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — operational instructions for AI coding agents (commands, hard layering rule, conventions)
- [README.md](../README.md) — human quickstart (prerequisites, setup, run, try-it curl examples)
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) — current phase, what's frozen, what's next, right now

## Architecture (how it actually works)

- [architecture/overview.md](architecture/overview.md) — the `Agent → Tools → Services → Plugin Manager → Plugin` layering
- [architecture/agent.md](architecture/agent.md) — request lifecycle, command_agent/database_agent, the vision_agent stub
- [architecture/llm.md](architecture/llm.md) — Ollama integration, tool-calling contract, failure handling
- [architecture/plugins.md](architecture/plugins.md) — the `Plugin.execute()` contract, sqlite/postgres, adding a plugin
- [architecture/database.md](architecture/database.md) — schema, repositories, the decoupled catalog-import reference table
- [architecture/logging.md](architecture/logging.md) — the event log, Job # tracing, per-stage structured logs
- [architecture/asset-inventory.md](architecture/asset-inventory.md) — real asset inventory + sensitivity classification (services, data stores, credentials)
